description: This PHP source file defines the TimeReportAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends a base ReportAPI class to handle API requests related to different types of time reports, such as project, activity_detailed, employee, and attendance reports. The class maps report types to their respective classes and includes a method to retrieve and validate report types based on API request parameters.

classes.name: TimeReportAPI
classes.description: API controller class for handling time report related API endpoints in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the report type based on the request parameter, returning an instance of the corresponding report class, or throws a BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
